title: Amazon.nl: defect within 2-year statutory warranty period
facts_text: I bought a digital thermometer from Amazon.nl 310 days ago. After about 250 days of use, it started giving inaccurate readings; it consistently read 2-3 degrees too high. The defect is reproducible and I am still within the 2-year statutory warranty period. I am asking for a remedy under the warranty.
request: Please offer a remedy for this defective thermometer under the statutory warranty. I am requesting either a replacement or a full refund of EUR 34.99.

strict.reason: The defect appeared within the 2-year statutory warranty period. Consumer rights allow repair, replacement, or refund depending on the remedy selected or available.

exception.reason: The defect arose during the statutory warranty period and therefore qualifies for a statutory remedy, typically repair or replacement before full refund.
